correctness.rationale: The product follows from proven full residue equidistribution, finite CRT, and an explicit O_G(X/B+sqrt X) large-prime tail. For any ratio sqrt(r_j/r_i), quadratic irrationality gives ||h ratio|| >= c/h; each prime p divides two floor values for at most O(X/p^2+1) inputs and must be O(sqrt X). All graph edges satisfy these hypotheses, and the remaining Euler product converges positively. Exact integer counts are corroboration only.
